title: Kling 4.0 Omni Reference put four separate character photos into one rooftop scene
author: Practical_Low29
selftext:
The four character swap clips made me try the reference-to-video side of Kling 4.0. Four studio photos from Nano Banana 2.1 (a chef, a firefighter, a ballerina, a DJ) went in as @image\_1 to @image\_4 with one prompt for a rooftop party. Handy if you need one cast across several cutscenes.

All four faces and outfits held for the full 10 seconds, and the chef really tosses the burger toward the firefighter. 1.43 at 720p plus 0.16 for the photos, under 2 minutes for the video. Ran through the Atlas Cloud MCP server. Prompt in the comments.
